# amusings

> > A Korean drama enthusiast's detailed episode recaps, series reviews, and character dating assessments covering time-travel thrillers, romantic comedies, and historical dramas.

This blog focuses on K-drama analysis with comprehensive episode-by-episode recaps of popular series like Alice, L.U.C.A.: The Beginning, Bossam Steal the Fate, and Backstreet Rookie. The site features a unique "Would I Date Him?" series analyzing male leads, plus full series reviews of acclaimed dramas.

## Key Topics

- Jung Il Woo
- Kim Hee Seon
- Joo Won
- Kim Rae Won
- Lee Da Hee
- Alice (time-travel drama)
- L.U.C.A.: The Beginning
- Bossam Steal the Fate
- Backstreet Rookie
- Revolutionary Love
- Episode recaps
- Character analysis
- Time-travel narratives
- Historical Joseon-era dramas
- Romance and thriller genres

- [Sweet Munchies Episode 12 (Final) Recap](https://kjtamusings.wordpress.com/2020/07/16/sweet-munchies-episode-12-final-recap): Final episode recap: Chef Park Jin Sung and Kim Ah Jin's conclusion
